name: wisp Grid
description: Sign in to a wisp Grid (RFC 8628), the grid and grid-tunnel transports, this computer's tunnel, and wisp Cloud as a share destination (ADR-0010, 0038, 0041)

commands.title: Sign in to wisp Cloud (or another grid)
Make a sandbox on the grid, as a machine
Delete a sandbox (its box and home)
Team spaces on the grid: list, make, show, add or remove a member
Signed in where, and this computer on the grid
Turn this computer on or off on the grid
What I've shared through wisp Cloud
Change who may open a share, its expiry, or its place in the gallery
Record a share taken in (for update available)
Report a routed task back to the chat it came from
